messages:
Rowan: Hey @Maya 1 starting this thread for Harbor onboarding. Goal: confirm owners, define success metrics, and sketch a 0-30 day plan. Who's our primary for integration and who owns compliance?
Maya (Harbor): Hi Rowan 1 I'll lead integration. Aisha (security) will handle compliance questions and Diego will run ingestion and tests.
Diego: Diego here 1 I'll need a sample schema and a small dataset. Prefer a Postman collection too.
Aisha: Quick compliance ask: we need to confirm encryption-at-rest + data retention policy. Can Sam (ops) share our standard matrix?
onboard-bot: Onboarding ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-7047 1 Owners: Rowan, Maya, Diego.
Rowan: Draft 30-day milestones: Day 0-3: sandbox + auth; Day 4-10: ingest + mapping; Day 11-18: integration tests + evals; Day 19-25: UAT + enablement; Day 26-30: handoff + renewal prep. Agree?
Maya (Harbor): Looks good. For success criteria can we target: 1) reproducible demo in staging, 2) median latency <200ms, 3) embedding cosine recall >=0.8 on our small set, 4) runbook and training recorded.
Rowan: Yes. I'll add: compliance sign-off by Aisha and a renewal risk flag if SOC2 docs not started within 2 weeks.
Diego: I'll take the sample schema and run tests once Jordan provisions the sandbox keys.
Rowan: Jordan (SE) will provision sandbox keys + attach a 200-row CSV and a basic eval script by EOD tomorrow.
Maya (Harbor): Great 1 I'll have Diego run the curl and post results. Also Aisha will schedule a 30-min compliance sync.
Aisha: Scheduling compliance sync for Fri 3pm PT. I'll post the invite here.
Rowan: Actions: 1) Jordan -> sandbox + CSV + eval script (EOD tomorrow), 2) Diego -> run ingest + paste errors to ONB-7047, 3) Aisha -> compliance sync invite, 4) Rowan -> runbook template into ticket.
Maya (Harbor): Thanks all 1 excited to start.
Rowan: Invite posted: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=harborkick 1 Sync Fri 3pm PT. See you then.
Aisha: Logged risk: SOC2 evidence may add ~2w if not started; impact = medium. Will track weekly.
Rowan: Perfect. We'll reconvene after the initial ingest. :rocket:
